children: US gaming REIT's Q3 revenue rose 9.5% yr/yr, slightly missing analyst expectations
Adjusted EBITDA for Q3 beat analyst expectations
Company sees 2026 AFFO between $1.222 bln and $1.225 bln
Company expects 2026 AFFO per share of $4.11 to $4.12
Company raises lower end of 2026 AFFO guidance from $1.219 bln to $1.222 bln
TRIPLE-NET LEASES - Co attributed performance to long-term triple-net leases with built-in rent escalators and strong lease coverage
RENT DURABILITY - Co said rent collections remained resilient despite a volatile macroeconomic environment, supported by healthy same-store operator results
DEVELOPMENT FUNDING - Co increased development spending, which contributed to portfolio growth
*Applies to a deviation of less than 1%; not applicable for per-share numbers.
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 15 "strong buy" or "buy", 8 "hold" and 1 "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the specialized reits peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Gaming and Leisure Properties, Inc. is $52.00, about 35.2% above its October 28 closing price of $38.45
The stock recently traded at 12 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 13 three months ago
